name: TaskNexus
description: Keeps TaskNexus in sync by delivering per-agent webhook bindings and secret-free full-roster health snapshots. Disabled until extensions.tasknexus.baseUrl is set.

configSchema.description: Base URL of the TaskNexus instance receiving binding updates and secret-free roster diagnostics. Absent means the extension makes no outbound call at all.
Externally reachable gateway origin TaskNexus should POST back to, prepended to the relative inbound webhook path.
